title: Effects of Regular Practice of Yoga on Subjective and Objective Sleep Quality in Primary Insomnia
brief_summary: The purpose of the study is to assess the effects of regular Viniyoga in patients suffering from primary insomnia.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

-primary insomnia

Exclusion Criteria:

* shift work,
* associated sleep disorder (sleep apnea, narcolepsy,..)
